articles.summary: Awards recognize and celebrate outstanding early childhood educators across the country Key takeaways: 25 outstanding KinderCare teachers from across the country earned the company’s Educational Excellence Award. Winners receive a cash award and paid professional growth opportunities. KinderCare has recognized more than 200 outstanding teachers since beginning their teacher award program in 2008. KinderCare Learning Companies, Inc. (NYSE: KLC) (“KinderCare”), a leading provider of high-quality early childhood education and care, today celebrates 25 outstanding teachers from across the country with an Educational Excellence Award. “Each of these teachers exemplifies the very best kind of educator we have in our programs,” said Dr. Lisa Grant, vice president of education for KinderCare. “Their dedication inspires a love of learning in their young students. We are all inspired by these amazing educators.” The top 25 educators were chosen from the more than 40,000 teachers KinderCare
articles.title: KinderCare Honors 25 Teachers With Educational Excellence Awards
